Geoffrey A. Mosley

Preserved Primary Document • mosly-g1.htm

On 24 April, 1907 he married Lulu DURHAM. His will dated 16 May, 1946 mentions sons: Wilbert and Willard Willard's children: Larry , Jerome & Janet Geoffrey died after a logging truck lost it's trailer and the trailer's attachment mechanism rammed into his car from the driver's side, killing him and severly injuring his wife. They were on their way home from attending church services in Milford, DE. He died on 24 January, 1953 and is buried at the Forrest Grove 7th Day Adventist Church in Cheswold.
